jobs.summary: I'm a working student on a team in Adobe Cloud Platform and Collaboration (ACPC). We run four event-driven Java services on AWS that millions of people use across Adobe, for example for commenting, sharing, search suggestions and an asset storage layer. Besides development, deployments and code reviews, I own the move of a production pipeline to GitOps on Kubernetes and initiated my team's shared AI tooling and skills.

did: Own the migration of a production pipeline from Spring Cloud Data Flow to our internal GitOps-based platform built on Kubernetes, end to end. I mapped the poorly documented system, developed the migration plan to move 10 partly stateful services securely and without downtime, and refined it with senior engineers into a 4-month roadmap.

The hardest piece is a stateful app that neither backup could fully restore. I moved its state onto a Kafka Streams changelog, so it survives failures, scales out across instances and rebuilds its smaller state faster.

Started the team's repo of AI agent skills for maintenance and repeated tasks. Helped build the team's AI harness: context and information on testing, CI/CD, architecture, our environment and connected services, for agents and developers alike.

Contributed to a multi-region CI/CD pipeline for new AWS regions and extended monitoring with Splunk, Grafana and New Relic. The services run on EKS, MSK, Aurora, Neptune, OpenSearch, SQS and S3, with more than 30 production deployments so far.
Cleaned up tech debt in multiple services: bug fixes, unified CI/CD (Jenkins, Argo Workflows) and secrets handling, major breaking upgrades and a large security backlog.
Fixed bugs I discovered, like a race in which concurrent CI and release runs could ship unreviewed builds to production, and a years-old account-linking bug that a misconfigured test had hidden.

jobs.summary: Tutor for Software Engineering II in the summer semester. I ran a weekly lab group, helped students and graded solutions, and took turns live coding in the lecture.

did: Ran a tutor group in the weekly exercise session, about two hours a week: answered questions, gave hints when students were stuck, and corrected and graded their solutions.
Took turns with two other tutors supporting the lecture with live coding in front of several hundred students. I showed the lecture material in practice and adapted to questions.

jobs.summary: My cross-functional team at OTTO owned product-data onboarding and its integrations, and I built and maintained Java microservices for it, from architecture and development to testing and deployment.

did: Built Java and Spring Boot microservices in hexagonal architecture, connected by event-driven data flows over Kafka, on AWS (ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudWatch) with MongoDB and Terraform.
Designed and introduced an AI-assisted development setup for the team, replacing generic GitHub Copilot: AI code reviews and custom agents tuned to our team's workflows and conventions.
Helped build a media asset service that consumes product-data events from Kafka, validates them, prepares uploads to a downstream media system and reconciles the media assets with that system.
Migrated a production service to a new, structurally different Kafka without downtime.
Took part in architecture planning and design decisions, refinement and planning, built CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, maintained a React frontend and patched vulnerabilities.

jobs.summary: msg.Pension Data is a standard product that delivers pension data to a central government service. As the only German developer on it, I was the link between our German product managers and client communication on one side and the Slovenian development team on the other, and I tested, documented and developed the product in Java and Vue.js.

did: Turned client communication into technical requirements and checked them against regulatory requirements.
Owned API and functional testing: designed, ran and documented tests with Postman and Jenkins, plus manual QA and code reviews.
Worked through Jira user stories and grew from small fixes to larger bugs and features in Java (Spring Boot) and the Vue.js frontend.
Designed and built a documentation-as-code pipeline as my first standalone project, and reviewed and extended the product documentation.
